contract.atomicFactSet: `LibraCandidateRejectedMessage@1` + current open Candidate Delivery/Reservation CAS + exact Candidate member set + Procurement Inbox dedup；同事务把Delivery置`rejected`、全部对应`proc_run_materials candidate_delivery → released+handoff_rejected`并冻结同一Receipt Evidence；Procurement Material Control保持不变；重复消息返回同一closure result，已accepted或Evidence不一致稳定拒绝
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Inbox写入前后、open Delivery CAS前后、Reservation逐项释放中途、Delivery terminal与Inbox result提交前后、迟到Accepted消息
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Delivery、全部Candidate member released+handoff_rejected、同一Receipt Evidence与Inbox result全有或全无；Procurement Material Control不变；重复消息重放同一closure digest，相反终态或digest冲突稳定拒绝
